scope: Voxel game domains and shared/root-game boundaries, plus the currently uninstalled Festival Night contractor module. Potential change impact, not an import graph or proof of safety.
direction: from is the changed producer/contract; to is a consumer or behavior that may need review.
integrationStatus: Festival Night engine, claims and demo are uninstalled. Integration-conditional edges do not describe current live runtime dependencies.
knownLimitations: Domain paths overlap intentionally. Conditional consequences need human review of what actually changed; no file-name match proves a defect or proves safety.
This is a reviewed semantic scope, not an exhaustive file-level graph. Unmapped files, new systems, generated outputs and deleted/renamed paths require manual review.
Root 2D behavior is mapped at its shared-data/runtime boundary; individual root assets, external platform behavior and private/unpublished lead work are not exhaustively modeled.
Current checks cover direct and active-transitive potential impacts. Future integration suggestions are separate and do not install or imply live Festival Night behavior.
Printed commands are recommendations only. The planner never executes tests, alters saves, runs builds, updates Git or writes reports.
Existing economy fixtures and software WebGL checks have limits; whole-venue balance, physical Fold 7 GPU/controller behavior and atomic host persistence still need focused validation.

domains.label: Shared catalogue and root-game data
invariants: Shared IDs, dimensions, prices and costume semantics feed both games; do not silently fork them.

domains.label: Separate root 2D runtime
invariants: Voxel-only work must preserve the root game's own behavior and save migrations.

domains.label: State, restoration, pause and initialization
invariants: The host owns its save version; save serializable rules, not renderer objects.
Restoration must preserve valid ownership, reached levels and finite wallets.

domains.label: Levels, home gates, unlocks and milestones
invariants: Reached levels do not regress; purchase gates and visible unlocks agree.
Use actual LEVELS thresholds rather than hard-coded earned totals.

domains.label: Pumpkin production, stock, freshness and streaks
invariants: Caps, held baskets and fresh batch availability must agree.
Harvest yield and streak frequency alter both income and arrivals.

domains.label: Finite-wallet retail, food sales and service
invariants: All businesses spend one real guest purse; reconcile holds, tips and confirmed debits.
Quotes, displayed stock and cashier animations are not sale receipts.

domains.label: Arrivals, groups, caps, VIPs, rushes and needs
invariants: Invitation sources share guest caps and finite wallets.
Fear, temporary return and confirmed final departure are different outcomes.

domains.label: Farm expansion, paths, exits and scene gateways
invariants: New plots/buildings leave reachable guest routes and visible exits.
Queue paths, draw geometry and arrival/transition strips must align.

domains.label: Litter, caretakers and cleanliness appeal
invariants: Cleaning targets actual reachable litter; do not duplicate caretaker work.
Pause, restoration and appeal penalties remain consistent.

domains.label: Ingredients, recipes, equipment, batches and chef
invariants: Only correctly placed kitchen equipment supplies home capabilities; premium equivalents count.
Pantry, deliveries, batches, holds and chef output conserve ingredient/food quantities.

domains.label: Garden harvest, carving seeds and pumpkin shapes
invariants: Harvested ingredients differ from deliveries, gifts and cooking.
Carving shape/session geometry and seed yields agree with saved state and kitchen supply.

domains.label: Sandy cocoa service and meadow comfort
invariants: Cocoa stock, lines, prices and deluxe automation reconcile actual payments.
Comfort and footfall share attraction limits; no extra unbounded invitation source.

domains.label: Hollow House restoration, foyer and paid visits
invariants: Unlock, purchase and restoration precede ticket sales; one charge per actual visit.
Foyer occupancy, maze completion, fear and final exit must reconcile across views.

domains.label: Hayride fleet, tickets, queue and paid circuit timing
invariants: Boarding charges one purse once; receipts, manifests and both tractors reconcile.
Paid circuit duration differs from owner POV duration; preserve route-at-departure and queue-at-boarding.

domains.label: Off-map geometry, scares, cameras and breakdown
invariants: Director, actor framing, route clearance and light/engine clocks remain aligned.
Owner POV scenes must not silently change paid operational timings or billing.

domains.label: Music, MIDI, scare cues and tractor sound
invariants: Respect activation, pause, visibility and bounded voices.
Engine, darkness, scare poses and sound cues follow the same ride clock.

domains.label: Home, estate, furniture, walls and physical bounds
invariants: Rotated measured footprints, supports, walls and floor origins match models, collision and selection.
Placed interactive gear and home gates agree with actual rooms and owned catalogue IDs.

domains.label: Costumes, walking, scale and companions
invariants: Facing, foot anchors, body scale and alternating legs stay consistent across costumes and rooms.
Pet art, physical scale, home poses and ownership agree.

domains.label: Inputs, cameras, menus and feedback
invariants: Physical inputs invoke the same authoritative actions; focus, hold-to-buy, pause and thumb targets agree.
Keep the world visible and controls clear across safe areas, fold states and controller back/confirm.

domains.label: Voxel kit, atlases, textures and render quality
invariants: Dispose owned GPU resources without destroying shared cube geometry; avoid empty box axes and unbounded lights.
Atlas cells, foot anchors, scale, DPR and zoom are coupled; compare budgets rather than assuming hardware speed.

domains.label: Orchestration, offline build, dependencies and CI
invariants: Keep simulation, input, rendering and save loading separated across scene transitions.
The shipped HTML embeds all assets; import/dependency changes need a clean offline rebuild.

domains.label: Uninstalled night definitions and goals
invariants: Targets remain draft; nights retain actual guest purses/caps.
Changing goal targets/windows/conditions invalidates active progress through its revision marker while valid permanent ownership survives.

domains.label: Uninstalled session, dedupe, pause and restoration
invariants: Keep captured session tokens, immutable outcomes and bounded per-goal dedupe across saves.
Manual/global pause freezes operation; restored service pauses without offline catch-up.

domains.label: Uninstalled read-only context and future hooks
invariants: Snapshot a valid restored world and actual placed kitchen capabilities.
Future hooks need real payment/completion, route/queue snapshots and final exit facts.

domains.label: Uninstalled cosmetic entitlement boundary
invariants: One stable grantKey per theme/reward; no duplicate furniture, coins or stat bonus.
Host entitlement and physical ownership must be atomic or idempotent; the module cannot make independent host writes atomic.

domains.label: Offline contractor fixture demo
invariants: Clearly label synthetic receipts; import no live world/save and make no real purchases.
Keep fixture controls usable on phone/fold layouts without external assets or game-storage writes.

domains.label: Semantic map and read-only impact planner
invariants: Distinguish active semantic dependencies from future integration conditions.
Unmapped paths or stale evidence require manual review, never a 'safe' conclusion.
